purpose: Goal-scoped procedural priors for the existing local UI planner. They do not register skills, prove availability, or authorize actions.
live_truth_rule: Current client frame and WorldState determine availability. Use only measured executable controls; after one action, observe and let the existing verifier decide.

ui_reuse_policy.execution_rule: Use existing frame-grounded UI element resolution and the existing executor. Never invent an element or coordinate; validate the complete state transition through the existing verifier or a single flow-level replay.

sources.scope: Community overview of recurring daily activity categories; prior only, not client truth.
Community overview of Bear Hunt conditions and roles; confirm all conditions in the live client.
Community overview of rally roles and timers; mechanics can vary by event and updates.
Community prior for Arena attempts and gem refreshes; current role, version, visible count, and cost must be read from the client.
Community guide notes an April 2026 Labyrinth update; unlocks, zone names, attempts, and reset state require live confirmation.
Community event guide; eligibility, refresh costs, and mission conditions are event- and role-dependent.

daily_rewards.success_evidence: client claim state changes or a reward result is observed
defer_if: button is not a measured executable control
daily_rewards.planner_hint: Open the visible daily/reward section, distinguish claimable free rewards from task progress, claim only an explicitly free item, then reobserve the same row or reward marker.

mail.success_evidence: attachment claim control or unread state changes
mail.planner_hint: Inspect the current mail tab and attachment state; collect only visibly claimable attachments, then verify the row or claim control changed before moving on.

exploration_idle.success_evidence: idle claim state changes or the client shows the resulting reward
exploration_idle.planner_hint: Read the current idle-income panel first; claim only when the client visibly offers the idle claim, then verify the claim state or reward overlay.

building.success_evidence: the live building or construction queue changes to in progress
defer_if: speedup or premium spend is offered
building.planner_hint: Inspect the selected building and queue state; start only a policy-approved upgrade with visible prerequisites. Never use speedups or premium currency from this fallback.

research.success_evidence: the selected research appears as the active queue item
defer_if: speedup or premium spend is offered
research.planner_hint: Inspect the research queue and current options; start only a policy-approved, visibly affordable item when the queue is idle. Skip speedups and paid prompts.

training.success_evidence: the same camp's queue changes to training
defer_if: amount or resource cost is unknown
training.planner_hint: Identify the specific camp and its own queue; use existing training policy only when that queue is idle, then verify its state changes to training. Do not accelerate.

gathering.success_evidence: the observed normal march changes to gathering or marching
defer_if: march capacity or idle count is unknown
the target or march state is unverified
gathering.planner_hint: Use client resource search and the policy-selected resource; dispatch only with a freshly observed idle normal march slot, then verify it becomes gathering or marching.

intel_and_beasts.success_evidence: mission progress, reward state, or observed march state changes
defer_if: stamina cost or policy is unavailable
intel_and_beasts.planner_hint: Read the current mission or target and visible stamina cost; follow the active stamina policy, act only on a verified target, then confirm the mission or march state changed.

alliance.success_evidence: the free claim/help state or associated counter changes
defer_if: donation or shop cost is shown
event timing or availability is unknown
alliance.planner_hint: Inspect the visible alliance section; prioritize explicit free claims/help. Do not donate resources, shop, or assume event availability; verify the relevant row or counter changes.

steps: check free claim or approved Goal
alliance_timed_events.success_evidence: a verified claim, event progress, or live eligibility reading
defer_if: event identity or timer is unknown
alliance_timed_events.planner_hint: Alliance event cadence, membership eligibility and costs vary. Use only live client identity, timer and availability; never substitute dates or costs from public guides.
alliance_timed_events.runtime_blocker: Existing alliance UI elements can be reused; production WorldState currently lacks the event identity, eligibility, and timer fields needed to select and verify a timed-event action.
alliance_timed_events.ui_reuse: Use existing alliance/event page elements and generic timer/counter readers; validate only the event-level state transition, not each element separately.

bear_and_rallies.success_evidence: the intended rally or a role-scoped march state changes
defer_if: event is closed or phase unknown
rally identity or role is unclear
bear_and_rallies.planner_hint: Check the live event phase, rally identity, role and observed march capacity first. Use only a currently visible eligible rally/action and verify a real march/rally state transition.

arena.success_evidence: the attempt count or verified Arena result changes
arena.planner_hint: Check the current Arena page and visible free-attempt count; do not infer that an attempt is free or spend currency. If no existing verified battle route applies, observe or defer.
arena.runtime_blocker: Existing frame-grounded UI element resolution can navigate the page; production WorldState currently lacks Arena attempt/result fields wired to a Goal verifier.
arena.ui_reuse: Reuse existing page-navigation, visible-element, counter, and activity-attempt abstractions; do not add or individually live-test per-button templates. Validate one complete free-attempt flow at workflow level.

labyrinth.success_evidence: a verified result appears or the attempt state changes
defer_if: route or outcome cannot be verified
labyrinth.planner_hint: Check that the current Labyrinth is open and an attempt is visibly available; do not spend items or infer a route from a guide. If the result cannot be verified, defer.
labyrinth.runtime_blocker: Existing frame-grounded UI element resolution can navigate the page; production WorldState currently lacks Labyrinth attempt/result fields wired to a Goal verifier.
labyrinth.ui_reuse: Reuse existing page-navigation, visible-element, counter, and activity-attempt abstractions; do not add or individually live-test per-button templates. Validate one complete entry/result flow at workflow level.

timed_events.success_evidence: event points, claimed tier, or live progress changes as expected
defer_if: event identity or timer is unknown
action costs scarce resources outside policy
timed_events.planner_hint: Read live event name, remaining time, progress and free-claim state. Prefer explicit free claims; contribute only through existing approved Goal policy and verify points or tier state.

hero_growth.success_evidence: the intended hero level, item, or claim state changes and is reobserved
hero_growth.planner_hint: Observe the current hero screen and cost first. Continue only a verified free claim or existing policy-approved reversible action; defer recruitment, scarce items, or unclear costs.
